title: Essential 8 and CrowdStrike Falcon Ecosystem
subtitle: Native capability, ecosystem dependencies and residual gaps

assessment_scale.native_direct: CrowdStrike can enforce or perform a material part of the requirement.
assessment_scale.native_direct_bounded: CrowdStrike directly performs part of the requirement only for documented platforms, workloads, applications or authentication flows; this must not be extrapolated to the full control scope.
assessment_scale.native_supporting: CrowdStrike supplies discovery, prioritisation, detection, response or evidence but does not implement the preventive control by itself.
assessment_scale.ecosystem: An integrated or complementary product, operating-system control or service is required.
assessment_scale.gap: No sufficient native capability is evidenced, or the requirement remains predominantly organisational or procedural.

asd_model_alignment.methodology_statement: This report follows ASD's model by treating the Essential Eight as a complementary set of mitigation strategies, not as eight independent product capabilities.
asd_model_alignment.maturity_rule: No Essential Eight maturity level is derived from the presence, licensing or configuration of any CrowdStrike product.
asd_model_alignment.assessment_basis: Maturity must be assessed from organisation-specific evidence of implementation and operating effectiveness across all eight strategies at a common target maturity level.
asd_model_alignment.exceptions_rule: Exceptions and compensating controls must be risk-based, documented, approved and regularly reviewed.

overall_conclusion: CrowdStrike materially supports all eight strategies but cannot alone establish Essential Eight conformance or maturity. Native strength is concentrated in Windows patching, endpoint prevention, identity security, phishing-resistant MFA and telemetry. Material dependencies remain for application allowlisting, Office and application policy enforcement, non-Windows and infrastructure patching, and cyber-recovery.

limitations: This is a product-capability assessment, not an assessment of an organisation.
The Essential Eight capability mapping used here has no detailed controls and no control mappings.
Several CyberDoc artefacts are draft, mixed or synthesis documents.
All ThinkThreats claims used for context were pending review on 2026-09-22.
Entitlements, regional availability, platform support and release state require tenant and contract validation.
No deployment completeness, exception population or operating-effectiveness evidence was supplied.
